fomod.Name: Pull Up a Chair
fomod.Author: Pull Up a Chair project
fomod.Description: Complete FOMOD. Allows experimental loading on Skyrim VR 1.4.15 and selects the VR DrinkPotion virtual slot. VR gameplay, headset UI and motion-controller input remain unverified. Keeps the existing flat runtime allowlist, EAS observer restrictions, artclean1 asset removal, paper3 background and compatibility choices. English is recommended. Source, licenses and guides are supplied separately.
